About Gadgetry

actually use.

Gadgetry picks phones, laptops, audio and smart gadgets that are worth the money – and explains them in plain English.

Our story

Tested for two weeks

Gadgetry was started by two support engineers who were tired of explaining spec sheets. We test every gadget for two weeks at home before it goes in the shop.

If we wouldn't buy it ourselves, we don't sell it – and our support team are the same people who tested it.

Support

Frequently asked

Are your phones unlocked?

Yes, every phone is SIM-free.

Can you help me set up my device?

Free on video call – book it after your order.

What does the warranty cover?

Manufacturing faults for 2 years, batteries under 80 %.

Do you price match?

Yes, any UK retailer within 14 days.

Which payment methods do you take?

Visa, Mastercard, PayPal, Apple Pay and Klarna.

Can I change my order?

Within an hour – call +44 20 7946 0333.

Downloads

Manuals & drivers

Manuals, firmware and drivers for every product are linked on its product page and in your account under Orders.

Privacy

Your data

We use your details only to deliver orders and provide support. We never sell data – write to support@gadgetry.tech to see or delete it.
